title_en: Hunan Jiahe County Forging Factory and Chenzhou Yisida Industrial Co., Ltd. v. Hunan Huaguang Machinery Industrial Co., Ltd. and Hunan Jiahe County Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory — dispute over trademark infringement
ruling_gist_en: In a trademark infringement dispute, to determine whether the allegedly infringing mark is similar to the registered trademark under which rights are claimed, it is necessary to consider not only the shape, pronunciation, and meaning of the characters, the composition and colors of the figures, and the structural combination of the constituent elements of the mark, but also the distinctiveness and market reputation of the mark or its constituent elements, as well as the specific circumstances of the case, including the historical use of the mark, the relevant public's perception, and whether a stable market order has been formed. A comprehensive analysis and determination should be made as to whether the mark as a whole or its main part is likely to cause market confusion.

full_text_en:
Hunan Province Jiahe County Forging Factory and Chenzhou Yisida Industrial Co., Ltd. v. Hunan Province Huaguang Machinery Industrial Co., Ltd. and Hunan Province Jiahe County Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory — Dispute over Trademark Infringement

Ruling Summary

In a trademark infringement dispute, in determining whether the allegedly infringing mark is similar to the registered trademark for which protection is claimed, in addition to considering the specific circumstances such as the distinctiveness and market reputation of the trademark or its constituent elements based on the shape, pronunciation, and meaning of the characters, the composition and color of the design, and the combination structure of the constituent elements of the trademark involved, consideration shall also be given, according to the specific circumstances of the case, to factors such as the historical usage of the trademarks involved, the state of knowledge of the relevant public, and whether a stable market order has been formed, so as to conduct a comprehensive analysis and determination of whether there is a likelihood of market confusion in the overall or main part thereof.

Civil Judgment of the Supreme People's Court

(2010) Min Ti Zi No. 27

Re-applicants (Defendants at First Instance, Appellants at Second Instance): Hunan Province Huaguang Machinery Industrial Co., Ltd., domiciled at: West Gongye Avenue, Tangcun Town, Jiahe County, Hunan Province.

Legal Representative: Zhou Anbao, Executive Director of the Company.

Agent ad litem: Zhang Shaojun, lawyer of Guangdong Huaying Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Zhao Bei, female, Han nationality, born on August 23, 1970, residing at No. 25 Yale Street, Shangdu Road, Guangzhou City.

Re-applicants (Defendants at First Instance, Appellants at Second Instance): Hunan Province Jiahe County Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory, domiciled at: West Gongye Avenue, Tangcun Town, Jiahe County, Hunan Province.

Person in Charge: Zhou Anbao, Factory Director.

Agent ad litem: Zhang Shaojun, lawyer of Guangdong Huaying Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Zhao Bei, female, Han nationality, born on August 23, 1970, residing at No. 25 Yale Street, Shangdu Road, Guangzhou City.

Respondents (Plaintiffs at First Instance, Appellees at Second Instance): Hunan Province Jiahe County Forging Factory, domiciled at: Jimaolu, Tangcun Town, Jiahe County, Hunan Province.

Person in Charge: Zhou Zhixiang, Factory Director.

Agent ad litem: Gui Qingkai, lawyer of Beijing Jija Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Jing Can, lawyer of Beijing Jija Law Firm.

Respondents (Plaintiffs at First Instance, Appellees at Second Instance): Chenzhou Yisida Industrial Co., Ltd., domiciled at: Tongxin Xiaoqu (Building 9, Wanghu Garden, Unit 601), Chenzhou City, Hunan Province.

Legal Representative: Zhou Zhixiang, Chairman of the Company.

Agent ad litem: Gui Qingkai, lawyer of Beijing Jija Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Jing Can, lawyer of Beijing Jija Law Firm.

In the case concerning a dispute over trademark infringement between the re-applicants Hunan Province Huaguang Machinery Industrial Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Huaguang Machinery Company) and Hunan Province Jiahe County Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory (hereinafter referred to as Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory) and the respondents Hunan Province Jiahe County Forging Factory (hereinafter referred to as Jiahe County Forging Factory) and Chenzhou Yisida Industrial Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Yisida Company), the Hunan High People's Court rendered the Civil Judgment (2007) Xiang Gao Fa Min San Zhong Zi No. 44 on November 19, 2007, which has already taken legal effect. On March 24, 2008, Huaguang Machinery Company and Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory applied for retrial to the Hunan High People's Court. On May 5, 2009, the Hunan High People's Court rejected their application for retrial by the Civil Ruling (2008) Xiang Gao Fa Min Jian Zi No. 49. On September 3, 2009, Huaguang Machinery Company and Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory applied for retrial to this Court. On December 7, 2009, this Court rendered the Civil Ruling (2009) Min Jian Zi No. 553, deciding to bring this case up for retrial. This Court formed a collegial panel according to law and held a public hearing of this case. Zhou Anbao, legal representative of Huaguang Machinery Company and Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory, their agents ad litem Zhang Shaojun and Zhao Bei, and Zhou Zhixiang, legal representative of Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company, and their agents ad litem Gui Qingkai and Jing Can appeared in court to participate in the proceedings. This case is now concluded.

On January 12, 2007, the plaintiffs at first instance, Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company, filed a lawsuit with the Chenzhou Intermediate People's Court of Hunan Province, alleging that the "Silver Cock" brand steel hoes produced and exported by Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory and Huaguang Machinery Company infringed their registered trademark "Pheasant Cock", and requested the court to order Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory and Huaguang Machinery Company to immediately cease infringing their registered trademark rights, make an apology, and compensate them for economic losses of RMB 500,000. Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory and Huaguang Machinery Company defended, stating that they had been using the "Silver Cock text + Cock design" trademark since 1999, and that the design used by them was significantly different from and not similar to the registered trademark of Jiahe County Forging Factory, that their products and the products of Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company had coexisted in the market for many years without causing confusion, and that they did not infringe the registered trademark rights of Jiahe County Forging Factory. They requested the court of first instance to dismiss the lawsuit of Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company.

The Chenzhou Intermediate People's Court of Hunan Province found at first instance: Jiahe County Forging Factory was established in November 1997, a sole proprietorship owned by Zhou Zhixiang. Its business scope includes self-production and sales of steel hoes, pliers, sugarcane knives, other farm tools, and hardware tools. Yisida Company was established in November 2000, with Zhou Zhixiang as its legal representative. Its business scope includes wholesale and retail of hardware tools, farm tools and other products, and self-operation and agency of import and export of various goods and technologies. In 2001, Jiahe County Forging Factory applied for and obtained registration of a trademark combining the Chinese characters "雉鸡" (Pheasant Cock) and a cock design from the Trademark Office of the State Administration for Industry and Commerce (hereinafter referred to as the State Trademark Office). The trademark registration number is No. 1641855. The designated goods are Class 8: hoes (hand tools), pliers, sickles, wrenches (hand tools). The registration is valid from September 28, 2001, to September 27, 2011. On January 1, 2002, Jiahe County Forging Factory entered into a trademark licensing contract with Yisida Company, licensing Yisida Company to use the combined trademark of the Chinese characters "雉鸡" and the pheasant cock design. Both Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company produce steel hoes and use the combined trademark of the Chinese characters "雉鸡" and the pheasant cock design, and their products are exported to countries in Africa and Southeast Asia.

Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory was established in 1997, a sole proprietorship owned by Zhou Anbao. Its business scope includes production and sales of steel hoes, hardware tools, farm tools, etc. Huaguang Machinery Company was established in April 2005, with Zhou Anbao as its legal representative. Its business scope includes production and sales of tools, farm tools, garden tools, hardware, and building materials. Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory began using the combined trademark of "银鸡" (Silver Cock) in Chinese and English and a cock design in 1999. In February 2000, Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory applied for and obtained registration of a trademark combining the Chinese characters "银鸡" and the pinyin "YINJI" from the State Trademark Office. The trademark registration number is No. 1364633. The designated goods are Class 8: hoes (hand tools); agricultural implements (hand-operated). The registration is valid from February 14, 2000, to February 13, 2010.

Both Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company, and Huaguang Machinery Company and Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory produce agricultural steel hoes with substantially the same shape and dimensions. Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company use on their steel hoes the Chinese characters "雉鸡" and a cock design (cock head facing right, tail facing left), along with the English words "JOGOOBRAND" and "Made in China" in Chinese and English with a diamond-shaped pattern. Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory and Huaguang Machinery Company use on their steel hoes the Chinese characters "银鸡" and a cock design (cock tail facing right, head facing left and then turning right), along with the English words "SILVERCOCK" and "Made in China" in Chinese and English with a diamond-shaped pattern.

It was further found that the export value of steel hoes by Jiahe County Forging Factory was: USD 470,000 in 2002, USD 140,000 in 2003, USD 450,000 in 2004, USD 70,000 in 2005, and USD 4.01 million in 2006. The export value of steel hoes by Yisida Company was: USD 1.01 million in 2002, USD 1.53 million in 2003, USD 1.51 million in 2004, and USD 3.89 million in 2005. The export value of steel hoes by Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory was: USD 630,000 in 2002, USD 640,000 in 2003, USD 730,000 in 2004, and USD 730,000 in 2005. The export value of steel hoes by Huaguang Machinery Company was: USD 2.82 million in 2006.

The Chenzhou Intermediate People's Court of Hunan Province held at first instance that Jiahe County Forging Factory, Yisida Company, Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory, and Huaguang Machinery Company are all enterprises producing and exporting steel hoes. The steel hoes produced by Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company and those produced by Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory and Huaguang Machinery Company have substantially the same shape and dimensions, constituting identical products. The trademark consisting of the Chinese characters "银鸡" and a cock design used by Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory and Huaguang Machinery Company, when compared with the registered trademark consisting of the Chinese characters "雉鸡" and a cock design owned by Jiahe County Forging Factory, showed no substantial visual difference in terms of text, design, color, and shape. The trademark used by Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory and Huaguang Machinery Company was similar to the registered trademark of Jiahe County Forging Factory, which could easily cause the relevant public to be mistaken about the source of the goods or to believe that there is a specific connection between the source of the goods and the goods bearing the registered trademark of Jiahe County Forging Factory. Without obtaining the consent of Jiahe County Forging Factory, Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory and Huaguang Machinery Company used a trademark similar to the registered trademark of Jiahe County Forging Factory on the steel hoes they produced, which fell under the circumstance specified in Article 52(1) of the Trademark Law of the People's Republic of China: "using a trademark that is identical or similar to its registered trademark on the same kind of goods," thus infringing the exclusive right to use the registered trademark of Jiahe County Forging Factory. They should bear the civil liability of ceasing the infringement and compensating for losses. On July 12, 2007, the Chenzhou Intermediate People's Court rendered the Civil Judgment (2007) Chen Min San Chu Zi No. 2, ordering Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory and Huaguang Machinery Company to cease infringing the registered trademark rights of Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company and to pay RMB 500,000 in damages; dismissing the other claims of Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company. The case acceptance fee of RMB 10,010 and other litigation fees of RMB 5,000 were borne by Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory and Huaguang Machinery Company.

Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory and Huaguang Machinery Company, dissatisfied with the judgment of first instance, appealed to the Hunan High People's Court, contending that the trademark they used was not similar to, let alone identical to, the registered trademark of Jiahe County Forging Factory, and that their use of the trademark did not infringe the registered trademark rights of Jiahe County Forging Factory. They requested: 1. Reversal of the Civil Judgment (2007) Chen Min San Chu Zi No. 2; 2. Dismissal of all claims of Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company in accordance with law; 3. An order that Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company bear all litigation costs of this case. Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company responded, arguing that the facts found by the court of first instance were clear and the law was correctly applied, and the judgment should be affirmed, and that the trademark used by Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory and Huaguang Machinery Company on their goods constituted infringement of the registered trademark of Jiahe County Forging Factory.

On second instance, the Hunan High People's Court found that both Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company produced steel hoes and used the trademark shown in evidence 10 submitted by them during the first instance; the trademark used by Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory and Huaguang Machinery Company on their steel hoes was the design shown in evidence 11 submitted by the plaintiffs during the first instance.

Although Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory and Huaguang Machinery Company submitted eight pieces of evidence, including evidence 10-17, during the first instance to prove that they had started using the "Silver Cock" Chinese and English text and cock design trademark as early as 1999, except for evidence 14 and 15, these pieces of evidence were witness testimonies. These witness testimonies only confirmed the existence of this fact but were not corroborated by corresponding evidence, and thus could not sufficiently prove that they had started using the "Silver Cock" Chinese and English text and cock design trademark as early as 1999. The court of second instance did not confirm this fact found by the court of first instance. As to the other facts found by the court of first instance, neither party raised any objection, and they were confirmed after review.

The Hunan High People's Court held at second instance that, comparing the trademark used on the allegedly infringing goods with the registered trademark of Jiahe County Forging Factory, although they were not identical, the prominent distinctive feature of Jiahe County Forging Factory's registered trademark lay in the combination of the cock design and the Chinese characters "雉鸡". On the allegedly infringing goods, Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory and Huaguang Machinery Company also prominently used a combined trademark of a cock design and the Chinese characters "银鸡" in a prominent position. Among them, the characters differed by one character from the registered trademark of Jiahe County Forging Factory, but both used traditional characters and were located at the left and right sides of the cock design. The direction of the cock in the design differed, and the shape was altered, but the overall visual effect was similar. Considering that both parties are located in the same county, Jiahe County, the steel hoe products have the same place of origin, the sales scope of the products is in the same overseas regions, and the consumers and other businesses closely related to the marketing have limited ability to recognize Chinese characters, it should be determined that, taking the general attention of the relevant public as the standard, under the condition of isolated comparison of the objects, and considering the distinctiveness of the registered trademark of Jiahe County Forging Factory, the trademark used on the allegedly infringing goods was similar to the registered trademark of Jiahe County Forging Factory, which could easily cause the relevant public to be mistaken about the source of the goods and cause confusion. The appeal ground of Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory and Huaguang Machinery Company that their conduct did not constitute trademark infringement was untenable. Regarding the amount of damages, the court of first instance comprehensively considered various factors of the infringement and applied the statutory damages principle based on the circumstances of the infringement, determining the amount of damages, which was consistent with the actual circumstances of the case and was not improper. On November 19, 2007, the Hunan High People's Court rendered the Civil Judgment (2007) Xiang Gao Fa Min San Zhong Zi No. 44, dismissing the appeal and affirming the original judgment.

Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory and Huaguang Machinery Company, dissatisfied with the judgment of second instance, applied for retrial to the Hunan High People's Court. On May 5, 2009, the Hunan High People's Court rendered the Civil Ruling (2008) Xiang Gao Fa Min Jian Zi No. 49, rejecting their application for retrial.

Huaguang Machinery Company and Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory, dissatisfied with the Civil Judgment (2007) Xiang Gao Fa Min San Zhong Zi No. 44 and the Civil Ruling (2008) Xiang Gao Fa Min Jian Zi No. 49 of the Hunan High People's Court, applied for retrial to this Court, contending that they did not infringe the trademark rights of Jiahe County Forging Factory, and that both the findings of fact and the application of law in the judgments and the retrial rejection ruling were erroneous. The "Silver Cock and design" mark used by Huaguang Machinery Company and Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory was used earlier and was neither identical nor similar to the registered trademark No. 1641855 of Jiahe County Forging Factory. According to the Trademark Law and the judicial interpretations of the Supreme People's Court, the similarity of trademarks is to be compared between the allegedly infringing mark and the right holder's registered trademark, but the original judgment compared the mark used by Huaguang Machinery Company and Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory with the mark actually used by Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company. This method of comparison violated the basic criteria for trademark similarity determination. They requested this Court to reverse the judgments of first and second instance and retry this case.

Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company responded, arguing that the allegedly infringing mark was similar to the registered trademark No. 1641855 of Jiahe County Forging Factory, and the ground of Huaguang Machinery Company and Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory that the two were not similar was untenable. The original judgment had clear facts and correct application of law. They requested this Court to reject the retrial application of Huaguang Machinery Company and Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory in accordance with law.

This Court found upon review that, except for the fact that Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory started using the "Silver Cock" Chinese and English text and cock design trademark in 1999, which was disputed by the parties, the facts found in the original judgment were substantially correct. To prove that it started using the "Silver Cock" Chinese and English text and cock design trademark in 1999, Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory provided the following evidence during the first instance: 1. A certificate from the Jiahe County Administration for Industry and Commerce, stating that Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory had been using the "Silver Cock" Chinese and English text and cock design trademark on its products since 1999; 2. Testimony of witness Ding Xiulan that in 1999, Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory asked her to help design the "Silver Cock" Chinese and English text and cock design, confirming that the mark was designed by the leaders and designers of Chenzhou Meiyin Factory; 3. Testimony of witness Yang Wenzhong that he started printing the "Silver Cock" Chinese and English text and cock design for the factory in 1999; 4. A certificate issued by Chenzhou Yuanda Advertising & Packaging Development Company on January 25, 2007, stating that it designed and produced product promotional brochures for Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory in 1999, and that the second cover page of the brochure used the "Silver Cock" Chinese and English text and cock design; 5. Testimonies of four witnesses including Yang Wenjing, proving that Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory started using the "Silver Cock" Chinese and English text and cock design trademark in 1999. Among them, witnesses Li Xueliang, Yang Wenjing, and Zhang Jianguo, the legal representative of Chenzhou Yuanda Advertising & Packaging Development Company, testified in court and were cross-examined by Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company, who raised no objections. The court of first instance admitted the testimonies of Li Xueliang, Yang Wenjing, and Zhang Jianguo.

During the hearing presided over by this Court, Huaguang Machinery Company and Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory provided the original product promotional brochure designed and produced by Chenzhou Yuanda Advertising & Packaging Development Company in 1999 for Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory. Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company argued during cross-examination that the printing time of the brochure was inconsistent with the actual situation and contradicted its content. This Court holds that although Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company raised objections to the original brochure, they did not provide sufficient counter-evidence to rebut it. Considering comprehensively the witness testimonies of Li Xueliang, Yang Wenjing, and Zhang Jianguo, legal representative of Chenzhou Yuanda Advertising & Packaging Development Company, which were cross-examined at first instance, as well as the certificate issued by Huaguang Machinery Company and the Jiahe County Administration for Industry and Commerce, and according to the principle of preponderance of evidence in civil cases, it can be determined that Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory had started using the "Silver Cock" Chinese and English text and cock design trademark since 1999. The court of second instance, on the ground that "these witness testimonies only confirmed the existence of this fact but were not corroborated by corresponding evidence and could not sufficiently prove that the appellant had started using the 'Silver Cock' Chinese and English text and cock design trademark as early as 1999," failed to confirm this fact, which constitutes an error in fact-finding. This Court hereby corrects it.

During the review of this case by this Court, to prove that they had used their registered trademark before 1999, Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company submitted delivery receipts issued by Hengyang Grinding Wheel Factory, a certificate issued by Hunan College Color Printing Factory, contracts with Guangdong Machinery Import and Export Corporation in 1997, Liaoning Machinery Import and Export Co., Ltd. in 1997, and Shandong Metals and Minerals Import and Export Corporation in 1998, as well as some railway waybills and invoices. Huaguang Machinery Company and Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory argued that the aforementioned evidence did not specify which trademark was used, was irrelevant to this case, and they did not recognize its authenticity. After review, this Court finds that, except for the certificate issued by Hunan College Color Printing Factory, none of the aforementioned evidence indicates the specific form of the trademark used by Jiahe County Forging Factory. Moreover, in the acquisition contract signed with Liaoning Machinery Import and Export Company dated March 14, 1997, and the industrial and mineral product purchase and sale contract signed with Shandong Metals and Minerals Import and Export Corporation dated November 13, 1998, the color of the characters "雉鸡" (pheasant) was noticeably different from other handwriting. The certificate issued by Hunan College Color Printing Factory is essentially witness testimony, which was not cross-examined at trial. This Court does not admit the above evidence. Furthermore, even if it could be determined that Jiahe County Forging Factory had used its registered trademark before 1999, based on the evidence provided by Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company, it is also difficult to establish that the disputed mark used by Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory was intended to copy or imitate Jiahe County Forging Factory's registered trademark No. 1641855, "Pheasant and Design."

This Court further finds the following facts: The registered trademark No. 1641855 "Pheasant and Design" of Jiahe Forging Factory primarily consists of black and white colors, composed of a chicken design and the Chinese characters "雉鸡" (pheasant). In the chicken design, the chicken's head is on the right side of the trademark, the tail hangs down on the left side, the tail is black, the feather layers of the chicken design are unclear, and the left foot is raised in a walking posture. The allegedly infringing mark used by Huaguang Machinery Company and Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory primarily consists of green and white colors, composed of a chicken design and the Chinese and English text "银鸡" (Silver Chicken), with a diamond-shaped border. In the chicken design, the chicken's head is on the left, looking back, the tail is silver, the feathers are clearly layered, and both feet are separated. Additionally, Huaguang Machinery Company and Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory submitted to the first-instance court some trademark announcements of registered trademarks in the same class and group as the registered trademark of Jiahe County Forging Factory, featuring "chicken" designs and text (defendant's evidence 18 and 19 at first instance), to prove that within the relevant product categories and industry, trademarks consisting of a "chicken" design plus text are relatively widely registered and used. The cross-examination opinion of Jiahe County Forging Factory and Yisida Company on this evidence at first instance was: "We confirm its authenticity, but it is irrelevant to this case." This evidence shows that on September 10, 1990, a third party, Tianjin Machinery Import and Export Co., Ltd., applied to the State Trademark Office to register the trademark "Rooster and Design," registration certificate No. 565627, with designated goods in Class 8, including hoes. Thereafter, from June 1999 to November 2003, dozens of enterprises and individuals, including third parties Luannan County Agricultural Tools Manufacturing Industry Association and Bai Huiyong, were approved by the State Trademark Office to successively register trademarks containing "chicken" designs in Class 8, such as "Black Chicken and Design," "Golden Chicken and Design," "Colorful Chicken and Design," "Crowing Chicken and Design," and "Divine Chicken and Design."

This Court holds that the core issue in this case is whether the mark used by Huaguang Machinery Company and Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory on the steel hoes they produce and sell is similar to Jiahe County Forging Factory's registered trademark No. 1641855 "Pheasant and Design" in the sense that would constitute infringement of a registered trademark right. According to Articles 9 and 10 of this Court's Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Civil Disputes over Trademarks, in cases of trademark infringement disputes, when determining whether the allegedly infringing mark is similar to the registered trademark claiming rights, consideration should be given to the specific circumstances such as the distinctiveness and market reputation of the trademark or its constituent elements. On the basis of comparing the shape, pronunciation, and meaning of the text, the composition and color of the design, or the combination structure of the constituent elements, a comprehensive analysis and judgment should be made as to whether the overall or main parts are likely to cause market confusion. The trademark in dispute in this case, Jiahe County Forging Factory's registered trademark No. 1641855 "Pheasant and Design," and the allegedly infringing mark used by Huaguang Machinery Company and Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory both consist of a chicken design and related chicken text. The registered trademark No. 1641855 "Pheasant and Design" of Jiahe County Forging Factory consists of a chicken design and the text "雉鸡" (pheasant), where the chicken's head is on the right side of the trademark and the tail hangs down on the left side. The allegedly infringing mark consists of a chicken design and the text "银鸡" (Silver Chicken), where the chicken's head in the design is on the left, looking back, and the feathers are clearly layered. Upon comparison, the chicken designs are visually significantly different. The text "雉鸡" and "银鸡" also have obvious differences in visual appearance and pronunciation. The allegedly infringing mark primarily consists of green and white colors and has a diamond-shaped border. Overall comparison also shows clear differences from Jiahe County Forging Factory's registered trademark. According to the facts found by this Court, within the industry of producing hoes and similar products, trademarks consisting of a "chicken" design plus text are relatively widely registered and used. Jiahe Forging Factory also did not submit evidence that its registered trademark No. 1641855 "Pheasant and Design" had high reputation before 1999. Moreover, before the registration of Jiahe Forging Factory's trademark No. 1641855 "Pheasant and Design," Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory had already used the "Silver Chicken" Chinese and English text and chicken design trademark on the steel hoes it produced and sold. Based on the existing evidence in this case, it is difficult to find that Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory had the subjective intent to borrow the reputation of Jiahe County Forging Factory's registered trademark. Furthermore, according to the facts found by the original trial court, before Jiahe County Forging Factory filed this lawsuit, Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory, Huaguang Machinery Company, Jiahe County Forging Factory, and Yisida Company had all used their respective trademarks on a large scale on the steel hoes they produced and sold. In the six years before this lawsuit was filed, each party's export output value had exceeded several million U.S. dollars. Therefore, although Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory, Huaguang Machinery Company, Jiahe County Forging Factory, and Yisida Company are located in the same region, the relevant public has distinguished the two trademarks, and each has formed a stable market. Considering all the above factors, this Court holds that the "Silver Chicken" Chinese and English text and chicken design trademark used by Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory and Huaguang Machinery Company is not similar to the registered trademark No. 1641855 "Pheasant and Design" for which Jiahe County Forging Factory enjoys the exclusive right to use. The original trial court's finding that the two were similar trademarks was improper in both fact-finding and legal application, and this Court corrects it.

In summary, the Civil Judgment (2007) Xiang Gao Fa Min San Zhong Zi No. 44 of the Hunan High People's Court contained errors in fact-finding and misapplied the law. The reasons for retrial filed by Huaguang Machinery Company and Huaguang Steel Hoe Factory are established and should be supported. Pursuant to Article 52(1) of the Trademark Law of the People's Republic of China, Article 186(1) and Article 153(1)(2) and (3) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the judgment is as follows:

1. Set aside the Civil Judgment (2007) Xiang Gao Fa Min San Zhong Zi No. 44 of the Hunan High People's Court and the Civil Judgment (2007) Chen Min San Chu Zi No. 2 of the Chenzhou Intermediate People's Court of Hunan Province;

2. Dismiss the claims of Hunan Jiahe County Forging Factory and Chenzhou Yisida Industrial Co., Ltd.

The first-instance and second-instance case acceptance fees are RMB 10,010 each, and other litigation fees are RMB 5,000, to be borne by Hunan Jiahe County Forging Factory and Chenzhou Yisida Industrial Co., Ltd.

This judgment is final.

Presiding Judge: Xia Junli

Acting Judge: Wang Yanfang

Acting Judge: Zhou Yunchuan

June 24, 2010

Clerk: Zhang Bo
